module: Tenant Isolation & Configuration Engine + Advanced Analytics
description: Multi-tenant support with logical isolation, optional physical database separation for enterprise tenants, request-scoped tenant context propagation, per-tenant configuration engine with feature toggles, comprehensive tenant-level resource limits, automated tenant onboarding with database provisioning, and FAANG-level analytics engine with real-time metrics, predictive forecasting, anomaly detection, and WebSocket streaming.
purpose: Logical isolation: Each tenant's data is scoped via 'tenantId'.
Optional physical database separation: Enterprise tenants can have a dedicated MongoDB database.
Scalable SaaS model: Shared DB for small tenants, dedicated DB for enterprise.
Thread-local tenant context for request-scoped operations
Auto-detection of enterprise tenants based on requirements
HTTP request tenant context propagation using TenantRoutesWithContext
Per-tenant configuration management with settings and feature toggles
Request-scoped config caching for optimal performance
RESTful API for tenant configuration
Tenant-level resource limits with CPU, memory, API rate, and concurrent request tracking
Real-time usage monitoring and enforcement with 429 responses
Per-tenant rate limiting with sliding windows
Soft and hard limit types for flexible enforcement
✅ Automated tenant onboarding with single API/CLI command
✅ Tier-based tenant templates (free/pro/enterprise) with predefined configs and limits
✅ Automatic database provisioning with index creation
✅ Batch tenant onboarding for bulk operations
✅ Webhook notifications for onboarding completion
✅ Template-based configuration initialization
✅ Template-based resource limit initialization
✅ Automatic detection and provisioning of dedicated databases for enterprise tenants
✅ Real-time metrics collection with lock-free ring buffers
✅ Session tracking with active session monitoring
✅ Time-series analytics with automatic downsampling
✅ Predictive forecasting using Holt-Winters and ensemble models
✅ Multi-algorithm anomaly detection (Z-Score, IQR, seasonal)
✅ WebSocket streaming for real-time analytics
✅ RESTful analytics API with time-series queries
✅ Multi-format data export (CSV, JSON)
✅ Tenant usage summaries and comparisons
✅ Tier upgrade recommendations based on usage patterns
✅ Automated alerting for anomalies and limit violations
✅ Circuit breaker pattern for failing tenants
✅ Multi-level caching for dashboard performance
